SeaSondeR

The goal of SeaSondeR is to provide a comprehensive set of tools for processing and analyzing data from the SeaSonde(R) High-Frequency Radar (HF-Radar) instrument. This package is intended to facilitate the creation of radial metrics files from spectra data.

Installation

You can install the development version of SeaSondeR from GitHub with:

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("GOFUVI/SeaSondeR")
